criteria.given: A broad typed model or malformed graph/reference/lifecycle
criteria.when: Standalone validation runs
then: Valid models are accepted and duplicate/broken identities, illegal edges/cardinality/cycles, malformed fields and lifecycle conflicts produce precise nonmutating diagnostics

criteria.given: A valid Engineering Model with decisions and dependent tasks
criteria.when: A digest-bound semantic edit or concurrent stale edit is submitted
then: Through a pre/post-validated action, attributable history, revisions, blockers and transitive decision invalidation persist; invalid/stale changes cannot publish or overwrite the last stable state

criteria.given: Canonical scenario/test references and coordinator evidence, possibly missing, tampered or historical
criteria.when: Read-only scenario and evidence projection runs
then: Assertions, actual outcomes and revision provenance are inspected through existing authority; missing/invalid/historical evidence is honest and inspection writes nothing

criteria.given: One revisioned model used by agents and humans
criteria.when: Public CLI validates, projects JSON/Markdown and performs a decision journey
then: Both projections retain identical IDs/digest and task/attention state, useful errors preserve data and CLI edits survive reload

criteria.given: A validated workstream snapshot and canonical evidence references
criteria.when: Interactive work/scenario inspection runs
then: UI displays canonical assertions/tests/revisions and honest evidence states, consuming the shared validated snapshot without duplicating domain-validation or repair rules

criteria.given: An attention item, valid/invalid decision form or concurrently changed definition
criteria.when: The developer records a reasoned choice then reloads, or submits a stale/invalid form
then: A valid choice persists and changes task attention; stale or invalid submissions reject without writes

criteria.given: Current and candidate document states, referenced specifications, external saves and concurrent changes
criteria.when: Any state-changing engineering action or specification change is admitted and published
then: Validate the current stable state before invoking the action and the complete resulting state afterward; failures or stale identities prevent publication
Every spec change invalidates affected validation, including linked-spec-only edits; startup/action/read checks recover from missed external-save events
Readers consume one validated generation, with content/dependency/rule-bound identity; incremental/cache behavior agrees with full validation and no broken or mixed state is actionable

Each enumerated public state-changing entry point uses the same guard; successful execution records exactly one pre-check, action, post-check and publication in order against captured input/result identities

criteria.given: An admitted v2 model containing standalone items, local support links, shared Tasks and qualified execution aliases
criteria.when: The human navigates known relationships or definitions are admitted
then: Missing containment parents and Story membership remain legal and visible; support links never fabricate ancestors or change executable ownership
Each product has one qualified model identity; each execution Task has a separate qualified identity; duplicate aliases for one execution Task reject within a model

Definition lifecycle, readiness, execution/integration and verification remain separate authorities; foreign products open read-only in their owning model without cloned aliases or foreign support edges

Concrete Scenario flow selects a canonical test-plan case by source work, plan digest and case ID; explicit coverage must agree with that flow or a reviewed canonical mapping; criterion overlap alone never establishes flow coverage

criteria.given: An explicit Story/Task subject, recorded context, live/archive refs and a selected source revision
criteria.when: The workbench opens a subject or another committed revision
then: Explicit valid subjects open directly; otherwise resolved context or a labeled chooser supplies the subject without inferring an Epic from the branch
Checkout, product subject and inspected revision remain distinct; committed foreign revisions use consistent model/source/evidence and remain read-only without checkout or ref changes
A shared Task retains identity across routes and Back restores the initiating context; unavailable records and ancestors remain explicit

criteria.given: A selected Task with known purpose, plan/spec references, relationships, owned work, tests and evidence limitations
criteria.when: The human opens Task detail, summary records or a decision form
then: Readable outcome and purpose, relevant same-revision spec passages and actual plan entry, dependencies, supporting Stories/Scenarios and scoped Tests are shown in context; an unplanned item shows no recorded plan entry
Every summary count opens its exact underlying records; blockers name their cause and current guarded decision forms retain options, attribution, rationale and stale-form protection
Titles, IDs and links alone do not satisfy context recovery; absent history or declared done never establishes verified delivery

criteria.given: A concrete Scenario selects a Test whose assertion depends on fixtures/helpers, with current or historical execution records
criteria.when: The human inspects its behavior, source and outcome
then: Show concrete setup/input, action, expected behavior and assertion with selected same-revision source and necessary fixture/helper/global definitions; explanation cannot override canonical assertions

Attach actual results only through existing nonmutating work/test/run/contract/candidate and report/log integrity authority; show retained failure output and recorded time/duration or explicit absence

Preserve passed, failed, not run, skipped, runtime error, stale, historical and unavailable meanings; expected narrative is distinct from retained observations, and case pass is distinct from workstream completion
Readable details expose the flow-specific association; criterion-related Tests are never represented as proving an unselected flow; technical provenance is explained in initially collapsed details

criteria.given: The workbench and recorded local performance baseline, including narrow and keyboard-only usage
criteria.when: The redesigned UI is exercised in a real browser with measured loading and navigation
then: Responsive list-detail navigation, accessible labels/focus/contrast and non-color status text allow the primary inspection and decision journeys
Initial Overview performs no test-source or evidence scan; selected detail loads lazily and cache refresh or changed inputs cannot hide stale or tampered evidence
Pilot latency budgets are measured with documented samples and misses; a technology replacement requires observed limitations and a reviewed amendment

criteria.given: Fresh adopted coordinator intake receives explicit, recorded, conflicting or unavailable work subjects
criteria.when: Explore/Grill work selection establishes a bounded contribution before branch creation, intent recording or delivery admission
then: The actual agent/coordinator intake invokes the shared read-only context resolver; tests drive that caller, not only a pure resolver or the proposed model context CLI

Explicit subjects precede valid recorded associations; conflicting explicit identities or material scope/ownership conflicts require clarification; branch identity alone never classifies a product subject
Reuse repository identities and explain source, contribution, exclusions, known relationships and execution owner; missing optional ancestors do not require invented parents
Unavailable tracker context stays unavailable and a later card alone proves neither live Task nor approved scope; inspection-only entry writes no branch, intent, node or assignment

criteria.given: Historical v1 records and explicitly proposed v2 definitions with optional containment and local support relationships
criteria.when: Validation or reviewed migration runs
then: V2 permits optional containment and specified many-to-many support while rejecting duplicate identities/aliases, illegal edges, broken local links, multiple containment parents, cycles and contradictory lifecycle/resolution
V1 retains its original rules; explicit independently reviewed migration preserves IDs, references and evidence attribution, and browsing performs no conversion or writes

criteria.given: Safe or unsafe spec/plan references with absent, malformed, zero-match, multiple-match or unique selectors
criteria.when: Captured context is inspected, actions seek admission or source inputs change
then: Unsafe or escaping/symlink targets and malformed selectors reject admission; invalid current documents permit only labeled untrusted diagnostics, last-validated inspection and explicit repair/import, with ordinary actions blocked
Absent optional references, safe missing files and well-formed zero/multiple matches admit labeled missing/ambiguous context without substitute passages or first-match selection
A missing required passage blocks its dependent action and the representative demonstration; unrelated guarded actions remain admissible on an otherwise valid document

Unique matches display captured text with path, section/task selector and inspected revision; bytes, selector, dependency/rule identity and missing/match state govern freshness, including linked-only, missing-to-present and unique-to-ambiguous changes

criteria.given: The specified WB-003 Task, WB-evidence-identity flow, qualified Test, retained candidate/runs and necessary helper context
criteria.when: The returning human completes the representative Story journey
then: Show the exact spec/plan selections, concrete flow, selected Test and necessary same-revision helpers/fixtures, with at least one genuine retained result validated through existing authority
Fixture outcomes, committed output excerpts and unavailable labels cannot replace required real execution; missing records or authority name an exact blocked prerequisite
The human successfully identifies purpose, spec/plan context, flow, setup, action, expected observation, assertion, actual outcome and applicability without chat assistance

Each identification has a pass/fail disposition bound to candidate/snapshot, selected Task/Scenario/Test and source/helper/fixture revisions; unresolved failure blocks demonstration completion until correction/review or an explicit escalated scope decision
Relevant definitions, source, context or evidence changes invalidate the human review; automation and existing execution/semantic-review requirements remain mandatory

criteria.given: The old harness example and its original historical definitions, plans, pins and evidence
criteria.when: The main pilot or explicitly selected historical work is inspected
then: The old harness is absent from the main pilot presentation; original records stay at their historical paths with unchanged identity and explicit historical inspection remains available

criteria.given: Versioned repository engineering definitions and optional supplied external references
criteria.when: Work is resolved or inspected
then: Engineering definitions, spec/plan text and code/test relationships stay repository-owned and revision-bound; inspection requires no third-party service or separately editable backlog
External identity/coordination context is labeled by availability and never introduces automatic API integration, synchronization, status ownership or authority transfer

criteria.given: A task has a recorded coordinator base and a later contract amendment approved through the independent review and authority flow
criteria.when: The coordinator verifies the immutable task candidate for integration
then: Verifier code and imports remain pinned to the recorded task base while the CheckPlan is derived from the candidate
Accepted obligations are loaded from the candidate pin and must exactly match coordinator authority
A candidate-only or otherwise unapproved obligation change is rejected

criteria.given: Required detached candidate checks exercise work-specific agent runtime synchronization, temporary consumer overlays, and isolated temporary sync roots
criteria.when: The sync, first-run, binding-overlay, canonical-source sync, and off-path sync tests run with verifier environment overrides and the coordinator verifies the candidate tree
then: The sync check restores every generated agent projection to its exact pre-test bytes even when an assertion fails
First-run and consumer-overlay tests do not let inherited verifier roots write into the candidate or alter consumer-owned files
Temporary-root sync tests bind writes to their temporary repository instead of the inherited verifier root
Successful required checks leave candidate source and CheckPlan unchanged for the detached integration integrity gate
